The relationship is supported by the indication chain from Thiotepa to mantle cell lymphoma, and from there to B-cell neoplasm, with scores reflecting the strength of these associations. The mechanism of action for Thiotepa is not explicitly detailed, but its use in treating mantle cell lymphoma implies a therapeutic effect that may target cancerous B-cells. The evidence suggests that Thiotepa may exert a cytotoxic effect on B-cell neoplasm through mechanisms that are not fully elucidated, but the existing pathways provide a plausible framework for its potential role in the treatment of this condition.
